summary: The urgent priority rule drops the page's 'Hb < 6' criterion, so anaemic post-TOP patients are not triaged urgent. The ectopic diagnosis demands closed cervix and small uterus plus adnexal mass, stricter than the red box, and the incomplete-TOP rule is not exclusive of the urgent branch. Other claims are faithful, with minor site-specificity imprecision for bleeding and products of conception.
